name: Interactive Star Field
description: Full-screen canvas starfield with a slow zoom drift. Stars streak and shift in the opposite direction of the pointer or finger, over a dark background with soft purple and cyan glows.
contents: Fixed full-screen canvas of streaking stars
Dark background with two soft radial glows
behavior: Stars drift outward from the center with a constant zoom velocity
Pointer movement adds velocity, stars streak opposite to the mouse and with the finger on touch
Stars that leave the edge are recycled from the side they are moving toward
Star count scales with window size, canvas resizes on window resize and uses device pixel ratio
editableByProps: Star color, size, density, depth range and drift speed
Pointer response through friction and easing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the glow colors behind the stars
needsCodeEdit.where: bg-[radial-gradient(...)] classes on the root div
tailX and tailY in the render function

fixed: Root is fixed and covers the whole viewport, it sits over the page unless given a lower z-index through className
Touch dragging on the canvas is captured and prevents page scrolling over it
Glow gradients are part of the root classes
